summary.text: Gregory Koenig is a Republican member of the Nevada State Assembly who has represented District 38 since 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Ballotpedia lists his profession as optometrist.

paragraphs.text: Gregory Koenig was born in Pasco, Washington, and his career experience includes working as an optometrist.
He assumed office on November 9, 2022, succeeding Robin Titus.
For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Education, Health and Human Services, and Ways and Means committees.
